verdict.rationale: While PlayCanvas can be used standalone via npm outside the Editor (playcanvas-docs-7, playcanvas-gh-2), there is no evidence of headless test runners, CI-friendly headless rendering, or documented unit/integration testing workflows against the real engine. Community feedback even notes friction with local/offline development (playcanvas-comm-8, playcanvas-comm-12), but nothing concretely addresses headless CI testing.
